recommendation: Keep the commit as-is for FHIR-32450. It resolves the remaining current-spec inconsistency while leaving the already-correct StructureDefinition untouched. Decide FHIR-32456 and FHIR-32459 only in their own reconciliation contexts because they are related media/network decisions with separable audit records.
issue_request: FHIR-32450 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested agent-specific AuditEvent.agent.location, agent.policy, and agent.network definitions, removal of AuditEvent.agent.media, addition of AuditEvent.entity.agent for persistence media used by an agent, and DICOM mapping updates for entity.agent and network[x].
initial_application: Commit 3d204189e23e03f0b4f11d03d491bc1d868e399b applied the main StructureDefinition changes for FHIR-32450 and related block-vote issues: agent.location and agent.policy became agent-specific, agent.network[x] replaced the old network backbone, agent.media was removed, AuditEvent.entity.agent was added, and DICOM mappings were updated. The active source/auditevent/audit-event-example-media.xml example still represented destination media as an AuditEvent.agent and carried a TODO to convert it to the new entity.agent pattern.
additional_context: AuditEvent is active in source/fhir.ini and AuditEvent/example-media is listed in source/auditevent/list-AuditEvent-examples.xml, so the stale example is part of the current build surface. Related FHIR-32459 later specified the network[x] Endpoint/uri/string shape that current AuditEvent already has, and FHIR-32456 clarified the persistence-media versus transport-network distinction. Confluence minutes and a Security and Privacy Zulip block-vote notice confirm FHIR-32450 was part of the AuditEvent media/network block-vote family.
reconciliation: Changed source/auditevent/audit-event-example-media.xml by removing the media-as-agent entry and adding a destination-media AuditEvent.entity. The new entity preserves the DICOM Destination Media role and DVD media type as entity role/detail and includes the responsible human user under entity.agent. No StructureDefinition changes were made because the authoritative element definitions and mappings already match the Jira resolution.
source_changes: source/auditevent/audit-event-example-media.xml: removed the destination media top-level agent and replaced the lingering TODO with an AuditEvent.entity containing media role/detail and nested entity.agent.

related_jiras.note: Clarifies that media is persistent data at rest rather than transport, supporting the media-as-entity correction but not independently decided here.
Supplies the network[x] shape referenced by the FHIR-32450 resolution; current AuditEvent already reflects it, but this issue was not independently decided here.
